'''Garagons''' were two-headed [[Reptile/Legends|reptiles]] from the jungles of [[Koda's World]]. Unlike [[two-headed tortuce]]s, their heads were on opposing ends of their bodies, rather than side-by-side. They were twenty-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] long fire-breathers. Garagons guarded the temple of the [[Tempestro]].
